plan.title: AD lesional vs control: DE genes + hallmark pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: Raw gene-level Salmon counts (12000 genes x 12 samples, 6 AD-lesional vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch) are QC'd with special attention to sample_01 (library size ~4x below median) before any exclusion decision, then modeled with DESeq2 (median-of-ratios normalization, Wald test, apeglm shrinkage, BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha 0.05) to identify differentially expressed genes between AD-lesional and control skin. The DESeq2 Wald statistic ranks the full gene list for preranked fgsea against MSigDB Hallmark (50 sets) to find pathway-level changes robust to any single gene, since a discrete significant-gene list may be too short for over-representation testing. Reactome is run as a second collection for follow-up resolution of hallmark hits. A parallel edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test provides a robustness check via overlap with the DESeq2 gene set. The final report consolidates DE tables (unshrunken and shrunken LFC), fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot, p-value histogram), and enrichment results (leading-edge genes, collapsed redundant sets) with full reproducibility metadata.
